title: GROW Branching Scenario
description: A deep branching learning scenario. Supports the three Artha-style branch structures: end after the consequence (tree), return to a shared path (spine), and carry a variable forward into later scenes (state). Node types: continue, choice, auto, ending. Pedagogical role is carried by `layer`, independent of type.

version.description: 2 is current; 1 (the original reconverging template) validates as a subset.

learningOutcomes.description: Observable judgements the learner should be better at. Each decision should map to one.

branchStyle.description: spine = reconverging; tree = divergent with multiple endings; mixed = both. State variables can be carried in any style.

variables.description: State carried forward across scenes. Choices/nodes mutate them via `effects`; nodes route on them via `branches`; text interpolates them with {{var}}.

meta.description: Free-form authoring metadata (author, version notes, tags).

effect.description: Mutation applied when a node is entered or a choice is taken.

branch.description: Conditional route, evaluated in order before the node's default `next`.

prompt.description: A reflection / metacognitive prompt shown with the node.

purpose.description: Author note: what this node is for in the learning.

button.description: Label for the advance button (continue / auto).

next.description: id of the next node (continue / auto). Omitted on choice and ending.

branches.description: continue / auto: conditional routes tried before `next`.

effects.description: State mutations applied when this node is entered.

delayMs.description: auto: pause before the advance button appears.

outcome.description: ending: honest result of this path.

debrief.description: ending: tie the result back to the learning outcomes.

choice.description: An option framed as a believable mental model, not a right/wrong answer.

mentalModel.description: The reasoning a learner choosing this would be using.

feedback.description: Optional in-world reaction to this choice.

quality.description: For the debrief only — never shown before the learner commits.

rationale.description: Why this option is strong / workable / weak.

effects.description: State mutations applied when this choice is taken.
